program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((colors (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (grid-colors g))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list colors)])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 2)
            (let ((a (first pts)) (b (second pts)))
              (cond [(= (first a) (first b))
                     (paint-cells out
                                  (map (lambda (c) (list (first a) c))
                                       (range (min (second a) (second b)) (+ (max (second a) (second b)) 1)))
                                  color)]
                    [(= (second a) (second b))
                     (paint-cells out
                                  (map (lambda (r) (list r (second a)))
                                       (range (min (first a) (first b)) (+ (max (first a) (first b)) 1)))
                                  color)]
                    [else out]))
            out)))))
